description: Search sections of textbooks and an R package on research methods and data analysis: statistics and hypothesis testing, regression and generalized linear models, causal inference (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, regression discontinuity, instrumental variables, matching, double machine learning), econometrics, experimental design, survey methods, marketing research, credit scoring, machine learning, and AI. Returns matching sections with their ids, a link, a snippet, the code languages they contain, and a citation.

language.description: Prefer sections with code in this language.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, e.g. "staggered difference-in-differences with never-treated controls".

source.description: Limit to one work: data_analysis (A Guide on Data Analysis); causalverse (causalverse: The All-in-One Causal Inference Toolkit); credit_score (Credit Scoring: Theory, Methods, and Practice); marketing_research (Marketing Research: A Technical and Academic Treatment); ai_in_action (AI in Action: A Reference for Artificial Intelligence); advanced_data_analysis (Advanced Data Analysis); tidy_finance_vn (Applying Tidy Finance with Python to Vietnam); tidy_finance_vn_vi (Tài Chính Ứng Dụng với Python); mlpy (Machine Learning in Python); social_theory (Social Science Theory: A Field Guide to the Theories, Effects, and Frameworks Behind Research and Business); publications (Research Articles and Publications).

name: search
title: Search the research methods library
